title: Asian Games: Norlan Petecio opens PH boxing campaign with win

blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Norlan Petecio advanced to the next round of the men’s 70-kilogram boxing competition at the Asian Games, beating Cambodia’s Sophor Vy by unanimous decision Monday at Nishio Gymnasium. Petecio, the brother of Olympic boxer Nesthy, earned 30-27 scores from four judges, while another judge scored the bout 29-28 in his favor to open his Aichi-Nagoya campaign with a win. Petecio battles Japan’s Sewonrets Ozakawa in the next round on Thursday. He is the first boxer to compete for the Philippines in Aichi-Nagoya. Up next is flag […]...
